scenicChapters.title: Chesapeake Country Scenic Byway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 36 km this is Chesapeake Country Scenic Byway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

chesapeake-country-scenic-byway.story: From Elkton it runs 214 km to Easton; allow about 2 h 55 of riding. On the way it passes Chestertown and Rock Hall. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
